basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old law school aspirant based in Chicago. I work as a paralegal during the day, and I'm passionate about acing the LSAT to get into a top-tier law school. In my downtime, I enjoy strategy games and exploring new tech in the crypto space. I'm in a relationship and spend my evenings and weekends browsing Reddit and studying. My typical online hours are late evenings, usually after 9 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Political Science and have been working in the legal field for about three years. I am self-taught in LSAT preparation, relying heavily on online resources and community advice. Additionally, I have a keen interest in strategy games, which has helped me develop analytical skills.
